noise-schedules.svg.description: Original plot generated by scripts/generate-noise-schedules.py from the paper's noise schedules, not copied from a paper figure. T=1000; linear beta from 0.0001 to 0.02; cosine alpha-bar with s=0.008 and beta clipped at 0.999. Natural log-SNR is shown for t=1,...,T; vertical range [-12,10] crops the extreme endpoints.
